INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY BOMBAY
INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AND CONSULTANCY CENTER (IRCC)
IIT BOMBAY RESEARCH INTERNSHIP 2023-24
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) offers opportunity for Research Internship
to eligible students for early exposure of Research and Development (R&D) in Science, Technology
and related emerging areas. This full-time research internship is awarded to bright students every
academic year on challenging research projects to be floated by the IIT Bombay faculty. Selection
of the Interns are done in response to the applications made by the prospecting candidates on the
basis of their respective academic record and performance in the interview to be conducted by the
respective faculty member of the Institute. The duration of the IRCC-IR-internship 2023-24 will
be for a period between four to six months (from December 2023 and June 2024)
Eligibility:
The prospecting applicant is required to -
be in the Second year of his/her Master degree program, or third / fourth year of his/her
Bachelor degree program.
submit application in accordance with his/her branch / discipline of study and in accordance
with the project requirement specified by the IIT Bombay Faculty (Internship Guide).
be among the top 10% in all the previous years in his/her discipline in the College /
University / Institute. A certificate from the principal (in the prescribed format) to this
effect is required to be submitted along with the application.
a full-time student while applying and till the completion of the Internship programme.
S/He may submit a partial project report before (e.g., in April) the completion of the
Internship (e.g., in June) if the academic calendar of his/her College / Institute / University
requires him/her to do so, with the due prior consent of the Internship Guide of IIT Bombay.
be able to work full-time for the Internship programme. Part-time internship is not allowed.
A certificate from the principal to the effect that there is no course work requirement
during the internship period has to be submitted at the time of application.
Detailed information about the IRCC-IR-Internship programme is available on the Institute
website - https://www.ircc.iitb.ac.in/IRCC-Webpage/IITBInternship/.
For any enquiry you may send e-mail to internship@ircc.iitb.ac.in
With best regards
Sr. Assistant Registrar, IRCC
summary: This circular from IIT Bombay announces a Research Internship program for 2023-24, detailing eligibility criteria, application process, and contact information.
